description: EXPERIMENTAL / STUB: inline "Add comment" action for selection-menu. Pins to a <review-surface>, which ships in the separate @profpowell/vb-project-planning package and not in Vanilla Breeze; without one the button is aria-disabled with a described reason.

events.name: comment-wc:created
events.description: A pin was added to the resolved review-surface (x / y are percentages of its box)

childAttributes.name: aria-disabled
childAttributes.description: Set by the component to "true" when no review-surface is found (resolved again on every click)

childAttributes.name: aria-describedby
childAttributes.description: Set by the component while disabled; points at the visually-hidden reason text

a11y.provide: A review-surface (from @profpowell/vb-project-planning) for the comment to attach to; without one the button is marked unavailable

keyboard.action: Start a comment on the current selection
